claim: the extraction deck's Poly2 short of the preamp's two 150 kohm ppolyf_u_2k load resistors is, on its own, enough to freeze the comparator's decision -- pop/pon collapse onto vdd, the StrongARM latch sees zero differential input on every strobe, and dout stops following the input. Issue #116: this is the SECOND of the two causes of the ADC_BLOCK stuck-code failure recorded in records/20260806-adc-block-comparator-smoke.md; the first (floating differential inputs) is fixed in gen_comparator.py.
netlist_provenance: schematic -- design/comparator/comparator.spice read verbatim; the loads-shorted arm replaces exactly its two Xrlp/Xrln cards with 0 V sources and changes nothing else
loads_shorted_dout_note: NOT part of the verdict. With the preamp differential at exactly zero the latch is metastable, so dout is numerical, not a decision -- it freezes at some corners and alternates at others.
